name: Multiresolution Decomposed Volume Rendering
definition: A general framework for rendering multiresolution decomposed volume data that enables systematic exploration of multiresolution structure properties. Properties include adaptive rendering, efficient coding, coarse to fine (progressive) rendering, feature enhancement, and error bounds checking.
summary: Multiresolution Decomposed Volume Rendering is a framework that renders volumetric data directly from decomposed coefficients without full reconstruction, enabling efficient adaptive and progressive rendering of large datasets.
